name: Capital benefit of CHF 1,000,000, Lugano: Ticino's 3% cap
workings: A capital benefit of 1,000,000.00 alone in the year (a BVG lump sum).
Federal: 1/5 of the tariff (at most 11.5% of the amount): 23,000.0000.
Ticino: the annuity it buys (50.77 per 1,000, table male) rounded down to 100: 50,700; the tariff's average rate on it 5.9921%, kept between 2% and 3%: 3.0000%; simple tax 30,000.0000.
